notice: Archive availability is uneven. This weekly sample cannot establish total annual coverage or bias.

method.selection: Every Thursday at 12:00 Europe/London, inclusive: 53 dates and 159 planned observations. Daylight-saving changes are respected.
method.archiveSelection: Nearest successful HTML capture in the hourly-collapsed Wayback index, within 24 hours of target; three BBC dates use independently archived exact-noon UK screenshots. Not an exhaustive list of all captures.
method.scope: Headline plus visible deck, primary main news area plus Channel 4 editorial Featured cards. Lower-page context excluded from primary metrics.

sensitivity.name: same-day
sensitivity.rationale: Availability-driven secondary view, specified after inspecting capture times and before compiling coded cross-outlet totals. The original strict primary rule remains unchanged.

coding.scope: Headline plus visible deck, primary main news area plus Channel 4 editorial Featured cards. Lower-page context excluded from primary metrics.
coding.crime: Explicit crime, alleged offending, fraud, smuggling, or literal illegality associated with UK migration. An allegation is not guilt; offending by anti-migrant activists is coded as protection/harm, not migrant offending.
coding.enforcement: Removal, interception, deportation, visa or accommodation restrictions, separate from crime unless explicit.
coding.channelRoute: English Channel migrant/small-boat crossings treated as UK–France migration route consistently across outlets.
coding.reform: Conduct scrutiny, adverse performance, and routine politics are separate. Allegations are not findings.
coding.limits: Different native editorial pools are retained. No rank-weighted visibility, actual audience exposure, total annual reporting, or causal bias inference.

method.unknowns: Gaps have null metrics and are never zero. Strict aggregate uses only weeks with all three readable, reviewed captures within tolerance and pairwise time limits.
method.units: Number of sampled dates with at least one qualifying card. Repeated Featured articles can contribute on multiple dates, but are not multiple new articles.
method.poolLimits: Native editorial pools differ in size, placement and available decks. No equal-audience, pixel-prominence or rank-weighted claim. BBC visible UK national block plus shared lead; hidden regional variants excluded.
method.review: AI-assisted qualitative coding, checked for source linkage, consistency and category boundaries. Requires human editorial review before drawing causal conclusions.
method.replayWarning: Archive playback may redirect editions or load current assets. Coding uses the retained timestamped HTML and its visible UK markers, or the specified screenshot, rather than a live redirected page.
method.publicExamples: Selected paraphrases, not a complete list of primary cards. Full pools were screened; primary metrics use all qualifying records.
